title: Warp figure plate
description: A technical-drawing figure frame: a 1px ink border, a title bar with a small code-bracket box on the left, a bracketed figure caption in mono (optionally between two rules) and a grid box on the right, then an inset ink frame over a faint dot grid holding a white, softly rounded card.
notes: tone soft swaps the ink frame for hairlines (for code panels)
card=false drops the white inner card so the content sits on the dot grid
